admission.justification: A future recovery must not commit unjudged memory, overwrite curator edits, or keep partial refusal writes. Byte/mode/index/topology restoration, edited-candidate and repeat whole-tree tests directly guard this worktree-only transaction distinct from closeout publication.

applicability: The admitted converted carryover apply transaction in the recovery leaf memory worktree.
conditions: Selection and exact external-memory leaf authority are admitted before apply; code worktree remains clean at selected official tip.

Prepared document/sidecar and missing/resumable record payloads are written only to knowledge/onboarding; route indexes regenerate before exact-tree validator judgment against the paired leaf memory base and official code.
Validator refusals and exceptions restore the pre-apply owned write extent, including preexisting bytes, modes, indexes and created directory topology; target edits/deletions are not overwritten.
Already-equal payloads skip writes but repeat still validates the whole tree and recomputes the worklist without persisting it.
exclusions: No standalone memory commit, Git staging/index write, official-checkout write, source-history import or ledger publication.
Public apply may skip a target-edited candidate while other admitted candidates proceed; the transaction engine refuses any conflict in its admitted payload batch.
Restoration is scoped to its owned knowledge/onboarding extent under normal admitted ownership; no concurrent external-writer preservation guarantee is invented.
Normal closeout publication/gating remains INV-HWAWFT and INV-49E649; apply does not claim those gates already passed.

evidence: Frozen generation3 source inspection; no new execution or acceptance.

statement: Apply writes selected converted pairs, regenerates indexes, validates the exact tree, restores on refusal, and never commits or overwrites target edits.
